localPrivacy: Your sessions stay on this machine.
heading: Your agents, in focus.
description: A live view of the work happening across your terminals.

liveMetrics.title: Confirmed session tokens
liveMetrics.confirmed: Last confirmed reading. Usage after this metric time is unknown.
liveMetrics.confirmedCounts: Input {{input}}. Output {{output}}. Cached input {{cached}}. Total tokens {{total}}.
liveMetrics.loading: Refreshing metrics; previous readings may be out of date.
liveMetrics.offline: Bridge offline or reconnecting. Previous readings are out of date.
liveMetrics.failed: Metrics could not be refreshed. Previous readings are out of date.
liveMetrics.stale: Current metrics are unavailable. Previous readings are out of date.
liveMetrics.noConfirmed: Unavailable — no confirmed session snapshot loaded.
liveMetrics.snapshotNote: Normalized cumulative session snapshot, not artifact usage. Cached input is included in input; total = input + output.
liveMetrics.provenanceNote: Compact evidence, not a retained full event. Time is source occurrence, not ingestion or other session activity. Observation time is unavailable; source was not rechecked. Workspace identifies the historical source.

unavailable.usage_not_recorded: No cumulative token snapshot was recorded.
unavailable.unsupported_adapter: Confirmed metrics are unavailable for this adapter.
unavailable.evidence_missing: The canonical total has no matching compact evidence.
unavailable.evidence_limit: Metrics evidence exceeds the bounded query window or byte budget.
unavailable.invalid_evidence: Metrics evidence could not be validated.
unavailable.identity_conflict: Metrics evidence conflicts with the observed session identity.

liveMetrics.normalizationNote: Normalized cumulative session snapshot, not artifact usage. Cached input is included in input; total = input + output. Missing source cache normalizes to 0 and missing total to input + output; original field presence is not preserved.

threshold.help: Visual alert for this open session only. It uses normalized cumulative total tokens (input + output, including cached input once). It is not a provider quota or spending cap and never stops execution. Nothing is saved; closing these session details or reloading clears the threshold. No system notification or sound is sent.
threshold.label: Total-token threshold
threshold.invalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 9007199254740991, using digits only.
threshold.reached: The last confirmed total is at or above the threshold.
threshold.below: The last confirmed total is below the threshold. Usage after the metric time is unknown.
threshold.distanceBelow_one: Confirmed total: {{value}} token below the threshold.
threshold.distanceBelow_other: Confirmed total: {{value}} tokens below the threshold.
threshold.distanceAbove_one: Confirmed total: {{value}} token above the threshold.
threshold.distanceAbove_other: Confirmed total: {{value}} tokens above the threshold.
threshold.exact: The confirmed total exactly matches the threshold.
threshold.unavailable: Threshold comparison is unavailable until metrics are confirmed again.

noResult: No final result captured for this session.
emptyBody: Start Codex in any terminal. Sessions from your configured Codex directory will appear automatically.
emptyActivity: No captured activity in this view.
cachedNote: Cached input is included in input tokens, never added again. Totals are observed cumulative session usage.
attentionBody: Failures and requests for your input will appear here.
interventionNote: This session needs input. Continue in its original terminal; remote control is unavailable.
observedNote: Statuses describe the latest captured turn. Inactivity does not mean completion.
notificationEmpty: No live notifications yet. Imported history does not trigger alerts.
soundBlocked: The browser blocked sound. Enable audio with a click.
soundReady: Sound enabled for this browser session.
search: Search tasks, agents, or session IDs…
error: Could not load local data. The connection will retry.
savedError: Could not save the change. Try again.
notificationsPermission: Browser permission applies only while this dashboard is open.
retentionNote: Event details follow the configured retention policy. Session summaries and totals remain.
noTurnTokens: Turn usage is available only on captured token records with a verified turn ID.
originalText: Captured text is shown in its original language.
selectSession: Select a session to inspect messages, tool calls, results, and source references.
limitNotice: Showing {{count}} recent events. Open a session for its full retained history.
linkUnknown: Agent paths in messages are source labels; they do not establish a session relationship.

analytics.title: Most used models
analytics.description: Reported usage from retained observations. Descriptive rankings within available coverage.
analytics.calendar: Calendar days in {{zone}}: today; today and the previous 6 or 29 days. Custom includes both dates. Queries use UTC instants from local midnight to the following midnight, with an exclusive upper bound. All history has no time limits.
analytics.identifiers: Agent and model filters accept exact observed identifiers, not names or inferred aliases. Available adapter options describe implemented observation only.
analytics.invalidCustom: Choose valid start and end dates, with the start on or before the end. No request is sent for an invalid interval.
analytics.incomplete: Incomplete coverage · Source coverage is unverified. Missing or retained-out evidence and intervals crossing period boundaries can exclude usage. These rankings are not complete history.
analytics.capacity: This query exceeds local analytics capacity. Filter by workspace, agent or adapter, then retry. A shorter period can still require the same retained history; model filters do not reduce the evidence budget.
analytics.busy: Another local analytics query is running. Retry when it finishes.
analytics.timeout: This analytics query exceeded its time budget. Filter by workspace, agent or adapter, then retry.
analytics.workerUnavailable: Local analytics is unavailable. Retry after the observer is ready; no partial results are shown.
analytics.invalidQuery: The bridge rejected these filters. Check the interval and exact identifiers, then retry.
analytics.error: Could not load model usage. Try Refresh to retry.
analytics.nonAdditive: Observed sessions are not additive across models; one session can appear in multiple rows.

comparison.title: Compare observed usage
comparison.limits: Descriptive, non-equivalent observations. Task equivalence and outcomes are not recorded; token totals do not establish quality, efficiency or a better model. Observed identifiers do not establish current availability or access.
comparison.scope: Choose two or three rows from this report. The same period, filters, measurement basis and incomplete coverage apply. Choices reset on refresh, filter changes, new observations or loss of connection. Comparison choices do not change the ranking or exported aggregate.
comparison.minimum: Select at least two distinct observed rows to compare. Unidentified rows remain available when present in the report.
comparison.unavailable: Unavailable: tokens per execution or successful task, mean/median task usage, active time, success rate and cost. Execution counts, equivalent task outcomes, measured time and verified prices/billing are not recorded.

analytics.denominator: Token shares and bars use {{tokens}} reported tokens across all rows of this query, including unidentified models. A model filter narrows this denominator; missing measurements are excluded, never treated as zero.
analytics.empty: No model observations match this query.
analytics.cache: Cached input is a subset of input and is never added again. Unavailable measurements are not zero.
analytics.coverageCounts: {{measured}} of {{sessions}} scoped sessions have canonical usage. {{unidentified}} unidentified contributions.
analytics.coverageScope: Coverage counts and gaps are scoped before the model filter. They are not a completeness percentage.
analytics.basis: Basis: retained canonical cumulative snapshot deltas, fully contained in the half-open interval; current workspace assignment. Observed sessions only. No interpolation or inferred model attribution.
analytics.updated: Last successful response: {{time}}. Refreshes on opening, filter changes and debounced observed events.
analytics.unavailable: Provider, cost, active duration, executions, reasoning tokens, task outcomes and quality are unavailable. Token usage does not establish model quality or value.

export.title: Export aggregate report
export.privacy: Observed model IDs are arbitrary metadata and may contain private information or secrets. Review them before exporting or sharing. Agent and workspace filter values and individual evidence are omitted.
export.desktop: This Desktop client does not support native Analytics save. Update the client; downloads remain blocked.
export.download: Downloads the current validated aggregate in the displayed ranking order. Your browser controls the destination and replacement behavior; ORQST cannot confirm that a file was saved.
export.blocked: Export is blocked until a new current report is available while connected. Refresh, filter changes, errors and reconnection require a new response.
export.failed: Export failed validation or exceeded its limits. No report was downloaded.
export.limits: This report cannot be exported: export requires at most 5,000 model buckets, model IDs of 1–256 UTF-16 characters and consistent safe-integer aggregates. The displayed report is preserved.
export.nativeReading: {{format}} · {{ranking}} · Read {{at}} · {{sessions}} observed sessions · {{tokens}} reported tokens. UTC [{{from}}, {{to}}). {{filters}}. Filter values are omitted from the file. Model IDs may contain private information. Save this confirmed reading only.
export.nativeHelp: Choose a native destination for this reading. CSV requires .csv and Markdown requires .md. Existing files require confirmation. No external application is opened.
export.nativePending: Checking this reading and waiting for native permission. Concurrent queries can be busy; there is no queue or automatic retry.
export.nativeRefresh: A new current reading is required before saving again. Use Refresh; changes or reconnection revoke the previous reading.

nativeResults.saved: Report saved. Refresh for another export.
nativeResults.cancelled: Save cancelled. No report was written. Refresh before another attempt.
nativeResults.failed: Save was refused before writing. Check the destination and refresh before another attempt.
nativeResults.write_failed: Writing failed after the destination was touched. A partial or changed file may remain; inspect it before retrying.
nativeResults.stale: The reading changed or permission was revoked. No report was written. Refresh and review the new reading.
nativeResults.unavailable: Analytics is unavailable or failed bounded validation. No report was written. Refresh before retrying.
nativeResults.busy: Another local query or file operation is busy. No report was written. Refresh after it finishes.

evolution.title: Usage evolution
evolution.basis: Covered cumulative deltas grouped by the UTC window containing their final measurement. These bars do not measure consumption within each day; intervals can cross windows. No interpolation or forecast.
evolution.filters: Uses the current ranking filters. Choose an exact model or the unidentified bucket above to inspect its evolution. Export continues to contain only the aggregate ranking.
evolution.failed: Evolution is unavailable or no longer matches this ranking reading. Refresh the ranking, then try again.
evolution.windows: UTC windows of {{days}} day(s), aligned to the Unix epoch; at most 64 windows. Empty windows remain unavailable. Coverage is incomplete.
evolution.undistributed: Reported usage with unknown time distribution
evolution.reconciliation: Measured windows plus any reported usage with unknown time distribution reconcile to the covered total above. Unknown is not zero. Initial lifetime snapshots are never assigned to a window.
evolution.empty: No covered interval with a known start. A reported lifetime total may still be available above.
evolution.caption: Chronological interval-end observations and token breakdown
evolution.missing: Unavailable windows have no admitted interval ending there. They do not prove inactivity or zero consumption. Cached input is already included in input.

desktopShell.nativeToggle: Native alerts for this Desktop run

desktopShell.nativeFailed: Native alert failed; check app identity and macOS settings
desktopShell.nativeLimit: Development app: signing and macOS permissions required

artifacts.title: Manual artifact
artifacts.manualNote: You selected one retained assistant/agent message. No automatic Markdown recognition or document completeness is claimed.
artifacts.loadFailed: Unable to load this artifact. No source content was opened.
artifacts.provenanceNote: Project and agent IDs are recorded evidence, not current manual associations or independent worker identity. Source was not rechecked; observation time and independent agent identity were not recorded. The source hash identifies the source record, not a saved document revision.
artifacts.retainedNote: Original here means retained redacted text, which may be incomplete or previously truncated. It is immutable in this panel. Source completeness is not verified. Maximum extraction: 32 KiB UTF-8; larger messages are unavailable.
artifacts.draftChanged: The draft differs from the retained original. The original is unchanged; this comparison does not indicate whether a file was saved.
artifacts.draftUnchanged: The draft matches the retained original. This comparison does not verify source completeness or a saved file.
artifacts.restoreWarning: Replace this in-memory draft with the retained original? Current edits will be discarded. This cannot be undone; saved files are unaffected.
artifacts.discardWarning: This draft differs from the retained original. Closing will discard the in-memory edits, even if you already copied or saved them. The original and saved files are unaffected.
artifacts.draftNote: Edits affect only this in-memory draft. Closing, switching sessions or workspaces, and leaving Overview ask before discarding changed text. Browser reload or exit may show a browser warning; Desktop window close/quit and crashes are not protected. Nothing is autosaved. Preview supports headings, bullet lists and fenced code; other syntax, HTML, links and images stay literal and inactive.
artifacts.limit: Draft exceeds 32 KiB UTF-8. This edit was rejected; the previous draft remains.
artifacts.copyFailed: Clipboard copy failed or is unavailable. Nothing was confirmed copied.

unavailable.event_not_retained: This event is no longer retained. Content will not be reconstructed from summaries or metrics.
unavailable.identity_mismatch: The selected event identity or source version does not match. Select a retained message again.
unavailable.unsupported_adapter: Artifacts are not available for this adapter.
unavailable.not_artifact_message: This event is not a supported retained assistant/agent message.
unavailable.content_limit: Retained message exceeds 32 KiB UTF-8. Extraction is unavailable; no truncated artifact was created.

artifacts.overwriteMessage: Replace this existing Markdown file? This cannot be undone.
artifacts.saveOpenOriginal: Save original and open in default app…
artifacts.saveOpenDraft: Save draft and open in default app…
artifacts.desktopOnly: Native Markdown saving and opening require the ORQST Desktop client. This browser has no file export controls.
artifacts.saving: Waiting for native destination or replacement confirmation…
artifacts.fileNote: Only the selected retained original or current draft is saved as UTF-8 .md. “Save and open” opens only that newly saved file in the system default application. No source file or saved history can be opened here. Check the draft for sensitive content before exporting.

saveResult.saved_opened: Markdown saved and handed to the system default application; editor display is not verified.
saveResult.saved_open_failed: Markdown was saved, but opening could not be confirmed. No automatic retry.
saveResult.cancelled: Save cancelled. No file was created or changed.
saveResult.failed: Save failed or the destination changed. No file was written. Choose a regular .md file of at most 32 KiB, or a new name.
saveResult.write_failed: Writing or verification failed. The selected file may have been created or partially changed; inspect it before retrying. It was not opened.

artifacts.navigationWarning: This draft differs from the retained original. Continuing will discard these in-memory edits, even if you already copied or saved them. Cancel to keep editing. The original and saved files are unaffected.
artifacts.navigationBlocked: Finish or cancel the current save before leaving this artifact. Your draft remains open.

modelObservation.historyNote: Historical session summary. The model observation time is unavailable; this identifier may differ from the latest model in the source.
modelObservation.availabilityNote: Model discovery is not implemented. Availability, capabilities and selection have not been verified.

modelHistory.title: Recent model observations
modelHistory.limits: Partial coverage: at most the latest 32 compact evidence records, newest ingestion first. Repeated identifiers are not model changes. Availability, entitlement and selection are unverified.
modelHistory.timeNote: Times belong to normalized events carrying an identifier that may have been inherited from earlier state. They do not prove the original declaration, effective use or current model. Source files have not been rechecked.
modelHistory.privacy: Identifiers are original untrusted text and may contain private metadata. Source paths and captured messages are excluded.
modelHistory.failed: History unavailable: the reading could not be validated.
modelHistory.allUnrecorded: No model identifier is recorded in this partial window. These records do not establish any model.

unavailable.unsupported_adapter: History is unsupported for this adapter.
unavailable.unsupported_schema: Compact evidence storage is unavailable or its schema is unsupported.
unavailable.evidence_missing: No compact evidence is retained for this session.
unavailable.evidence_limit: History unavailable: evidence exceeds the reading limit.
unavailable.invalid_evidence: History unavailable: evidence could not be validated.
unavailable.identity_conflict: History unavailable: session evidence identity conflicts.

observedTools.title: Observed tool input and output
observedTools.boundary: Read-only tool records from an external Codex session. This is not a terminal transcript or a process connection. Start, input, interrupt and resume are unavailable.
observedTools.coverage: Partial loaded history only: at most {{records}} tool records from the last {{inspected}} loaded events, with {{text}} display characters per text field. Records can be missing, redacted or truncated before this view; redaction is best-effort.
observedTools.controls: Captured content is plain text. Terminal controls (except newline/tab) and direction characters are shown as Unicode escapes; no terminal sequences, links or commands are executed.
observedTools.offline: Disconnected or refreshing: retained records are historical, not live output.
observedTools.failed: History could not be refreshed. The records shown may be incomplete or out of date.
observedTools.limited: The display window limit was reached. Earlier loaded records are omitted; use Activity to browse other retained events.
observedTools.invalid: Some tool records could not be validated for this view and were omitted.
observedTools.empty: No supported tool records in this loaded window. This does not prove that no tools ran.
observedTools.paired: Invocation and return with matching recorded identity
observedTools.unpaired: Separate record — no unique pair in this window
observedTools.noText: No retained text. An empty or missing record does not prove empty process output.
observedTools.truncated: Display shortened. This is not the complete retained field.
observedTools.sourceNote: Retained event {{sequence}}. Source was not rechecked; this record does not prove process liveness, exit, success or terminal ownership.

palette.title: Search & commands
palette.search: Search views, workspaces, agents, models or session IDs
palette.help: Searches the loaded local snapshot. ↑ / ↓ to move, Enter to open, Escape to close. No agent commands are sent.
palette.empty: No matching views, workspaces or sessions.

workspaces.description: Explore observed projects and their sessions, with a separate context for each workspace.
workspaces.empty: No workspaces recorded. Use Codex outside ORQST or add a local workspace label.
workspaces.localNote: Workspace paths are labels and observed working directories. Opening a workspace filters observations; it does not open files, launch a CLI or resume a process.
workspaces.pinScope: Pins are local to this browser/Desktop profile. Pinned workspaces appear first, using the selected sort within each group. Pinning does not change the active workspace.
workspaces.pinStorageUnavailable: Pins apply for this visit. Local storage is unavailable; changes may be lost when you leave.
workspaces.pinLimit: Up to {{count}} workspaces can be pinned. Unpin one to add another.
workspaces.noPinnedMatches: No pinned workspaces match. Show all workspaces to find and pin a project.
workspaces.clearedPins: All workspace pins cleared. Only this profile preference changed.

agents.description: Inspect the capabilities declared by the local observation adapters.
agents.discoveryNote: This is an adapter inventory, not a machine installation scan. Executable paths, installed versions, authentication and currently available models are not detected.
agents.limits: Capabilities describe source-backed observation support. A recorded running turn does not prove process liveness. Managed execution, terminal input and model changes are unavailable.
agents.evidenceNote: Evidence descriptions are supplied by the adapters and kept in their original language.

notifications.sourceMissing: The source session is no longer available.

settings.description: Language, reading comfort and notification delivery, with clear local storage boundaries.
settings.languageHelp: Language applies to the interface. Captured agent content stays in its original language.
settings.appearanceHelp: Choose a dashboard theme and reading comfort. Changes apply immediately across views.
settings.densityHelp: Comfortable spacing enlarges controls, table rows, workspace cards and activity entries.
settings.osReduced: Your system requests reduced motion. Animations and transitions remain disabled in either option.
settings.osStandard: Your system allows motion. Choose Reduce motion to disable animations and transitions here.
settings.zoomHelp: Browser zoom remains available in addition to these text settings. Reading choices never alter captured text, copied Markdown, exports or saved files.
settings.localScope: Appearance is saved in this browser or Desktop profile, separately from workspace and notification preferences.
settings.storageUnavailable: Appearance applies for this visit. Local storage is unavailable, so it may reset after reload.
settings.resetHelp: Restore dark theme, standard contrast, compact spacing, system motion, standard text sizes and original reading typography? Language, workspace selection, notification preferences, captured history and artifact drafts are unchanged.
settings.notificationScope: Categories and sound are saved by the local Bridge and shared by connected dashboards. Browser permission is managed by the browser; audio may need activation again after reload.
settings.notificationsUnavailable: Notification preferences require a current Bridge connection. Reading comfort and language remain available.
settings.privacyHelp: Observation history is stored in the local Bridge SQLite database. Interface preferences stay in this browser or Desktop profile. Captured text is untrusted and redaction is best-effort.
settings.privacyLimit: Appearance reset changes only appearance preferences. This screen does not delete history, change retention, access provider credentials or modify native agent sessions.
settings.textSizeHelp: Scale interface text to 100%, 112.5% or 125%. Layout spacing remains a separate choice.
settings.contentSizeHelp: Add 0%, 15% or 30% to the reading size of captured task text, expanded messages, tool text and Artifacts. Interface text scaling also applies.
settings.contentFontHelp: Change the reading font of captured text and Artifact drafts. Original typography keeps the existing fonts; code blocks in the Markdown preview always remain monospace. Source references and metric values keep their typography.
settings.interfaceSample: Observed activity stays available while you adjust reading comfort.
settings.contentSample:

terminalNative.input: Enable keyboard input for this owned process for up to two minutes?
terminalNative.paste: Send this exact quoted text to this owned process?

overviewLayout.help: Changes apply immediately. Show or hide panels and move them with the arrow buttons. The first visible panel gets the wide column; the others follow in order. Narrow screens stack them in the same reading order.
overviewLayout.scope: Only this browser/Desktop profile layout changes, across all workspaces. Summary, sessions and session details remain available. Hiding Attention does not silence notifications or change observed states. No history or drafts are deleted.
overviewLayout.empty: Optional overview panels are hidden. Customize the layout to show them again.
overviewLayout.storageUnavailable: Layout applies for this visit. Local storage is unavailable, so it may not survive reload.

terminalLab.title: Synthetic native Terminal lab
terminalLab.scope: Disposable engineering acceptance only. No user project, external session, credential or real provider is used. The fixture exits after eight seconds.
terminalLab.provider: Codex is the first provider candidate; managed execution is unavailable. Claude Code and OpenCode remain unvalidated.
terminalLab.paste: Exact fixture input (ping, size or exit followed by a newline)
terminalLab.ok: Request processed; exit requires explicit evidence.
terminalLab.idle: No owned process has been started.

artifactLibrary.title: Artifact library
artifactLibrary.description: Find retained message sources and open the manual Artifact workflow.
artifactLibrary.scope: Search covers loaded observations only, within the selected workspace and session. Sources are retained Codex assistant/agent messages, not saved files, drafts or automatically detected documents. Workspace filters use the current session association.
artifactLibrary.search: Search loaded text, agents, sessions or workspaces
artifactLibrary.coverage: Matching sources: {{count}} · Loaded sources: {{sources}} · Observations read: {{scanned}}
artifactLibrary.offline: Connection unavailable. Loaded sources may be out of date; opening and loading require reconnection.
artifactLibrary.newer: New observations are available. Refresh sources to include them.
artifactLibrary.failed: Unable to load sources. Refresh or retry loading older observations; existing results may be out of date.
artifactLibrary.empty: No matching sources in the loaded observations. Try another search/session or load older observations.
artifactLibrary.limit: Reading limit reached ({{observations}} observations or {{sources}} sources). Choose a specific session to explore its history.
artifactLibrary.end: End of retained observations for this reading. Retention may have removed earlier content.

observationGuide.title: Observation guide
observationGuide.intro: Follow the path from local source files to retained observations. This guide reads the existing Bridge snapshot; it does not test your installation or start an agent.
observationGuide.offline: The local Bridge is disconnected. Reconnection is automatic.
observationGuide.snapshotError: The Bridge snapshot could not be loaded. The dashboard retries automatically.
observationGuide.connectionHelp: A connected dashboard confirms transport only. It does not prove a successful source scan or a running agent process.
observationGuide.stale: Source diagnostics and session counts below are from the last loaded snapshot and may be out of date.
observationGuide.scanning: A source scan was in progress in this snapshot.
observationGuide.notScanning: No source scan was in progress in this snapshot.
observationGuide.counterHelp: Record, skipped-read and error counters accumulate during this observer run. They are not a diagnosis of the current scan; zero errors does not prove complete coverage.
observationGuide.noDiagnostics: Source diagnostics are unavailable until a snapshot is loaded.
observationGuide.sourceHelp: Use your existing Codex workflow in its original terminal. ORQST reads the configured session directory without changing its files. Claude Code and OpenCode observation remain unimplemented.
observationGuide.pathHelp: If expected sessions are missing, confirm the Bridge session-directory setting
observationGuide.sessionCount_one: {{count}} retained session in the loaded snapshot, across all workspaces.
observationGuide.sessionCount_other: {{count}} retained sessions in the loaded snapshot, across all workspaces.
observationGuide.noHistory: Session history is unavailable until a snapshot is loaded.
observationGuide.historyHelp: Workspace, search and status filters do not change this count. Retained history is not proof of a running process or complete source coverage. Open a recorded workspace, then a session to inspect its timeline and source references.
observationGuide.emptyHistory: No sessions are retained in this snapshot. Check source diagnostics and the configured directory if you expected existing history; no new session is required to inspect this guide.
observationGuide.privacy: Opening this guide does not request permissions, run commands, write settings or change session files. Nothing is marked complete or saved as onboarding progress. Reopen it from Settings or Search & commands.

managedTerminal.selectionRetryReady: Opening failed before admission/Core and all partial views were cleaned up. No claim, journal or provider was created. Create or select and review a pair again in this Desktop run; retained manifests and reservations are unchanged.
managedTerminal.selectionFocusRequired: Bring the ORQST dashboard to the foreground with macOS unlocked, then retry the native menu action. No creation, opening or authorization occurred.
managedTerminal.createPair: Create and review terminal pair A/B…
managedTerminal.createProvider: Choose the provider or mixed pair to prepare. Nothing will start.
managedTerminal.createExecutable: Select that CLI’s native executable (canonical file; no shim)
managedTerminal.createNode: Select the installed Node 24 executable used by both terminals
managedTerminal.createProject: Select an empty disposable project folder shared by A and B
managedTerminal.createMcp_codex: Configure optional ORQST A→B→A MCP? Codex retains native MCP definitions. This prepares configuration only; native compatibility and idle delivery are unvalidated. Delegation requires a separate task grant after both signed starts.
managedTerminal.createMcp_claude: Configure optional ORQST A→B→A MCP? Strict selection EXCLUDES native MCP definitions for these new processes only. Native project/policy approvals can block startup. Compatibility and idle delivery are unvalidated; a separate task grant remains required.
managedTerminal.createMcp_opencode: Prepare optional ORQST MCP configuration? It MERGES with native definitions. MCP configuration does not authorize writable native SQLite, possible migrations or provider/network startup activity. The next review can keep startup blocked or require a separate explicit acknowledgment of these effects.
managedTerminal.createReview: Create the reviewed private terminal manifests and skeletons? Review the entire configuration. This writes only new ORQST state under this Desktop profile. No Core, journal, admission claim, CLI, login or task starts. OpenCode stays blocked. Creation is separate from selection, opening and signed startup; reservations are preserved. One write attempt per selection until safe retirement; incomplete state is retained inert. Cancelling the next selection review keeps completed files.
managedTerminal.createAcknowledgment: I declare the selected CLI version and Node 24, and acknowledge SHARED native login/configuration/session writes after separately authorized startup. Native hooks/plugins/MCPs may cause activity or costs; real-provider acceptance remains pending.
managedTerminal.creationDenied: Creation refused or incomplete: use canonical trusted binaries, the reviewed version/hash and an empty project. No CLI was started. Any newly written partial state is retained; do not delete reservations or retry uncertain state. Completed files can be selected through the existing native review. No credentials or native database were inspected.
managedTerminal.selectManifests: Select and review existing terminal manifests…
managedTerminal.chooseManifests: Select private terminal.json files in one project, within the configured limit. Use one provider, or exactly one Codex and one OpenCode. Selection order determines tabs A onward. Nothing is started or provisioned by this review.
managedTerminal.reviewManifests: Keep this selection in memory? Review every complete manifest page and its blockers. This creates no Core, journal, reservation or provider. Open a terminal separately to initialize the selected Desktop runtime and its journals; blocked selections create only views. Starting each CLI still requires its own signed native confirmation. Native configuration can cause provider activity and costs at startup. Opening locks this selection until proved retirement and complete cleanup; uncertain effects and existing reservations remain protected.
managedTerminal.selectionDenied: Selection refused: choose complete private manifests in one project within the configured terminal limit. Use one provider, or exactly one Codex and one OpenCode. Changed files, unsupported configuration, duplicate identities, overlapping state and individual review pages larger than 4096 characters are refused. Nothing was started or provisioned.
managedTerminal.selectionOpenDenied: The reviewed selection could not be opened. No CLI was started by opening. A proven failure before admission/Core with complete view cleanup permits a fresh review. If admission/Core was entered or any effect is uncertain, this run remains locked; preserve all journals and reservations. Changed files require review again.
managedTerminal.reuseScope: Experimental Codex native login reuse. Native configuration, MCPs, skills and session root stay shared; Codex may refresh credentials and write new sessions. Not ephemeral or a container. Read-only/on-request startup defaults; provider UI can change permissions. No automatic task, resume or login. Real-provider and MCP integration acceptance are pending; OpenCode requires its separate explicit startup opt-in.
managedTerminal.reuseIdle: No owned process started. Start requires native confirmation. Separate login is disabled for this native reuse profile.
managedTerminal.focus_required: Bring this terminal panel to the foreground with macOS unlocked, then retry the action. No operation was authorized.
managedTerminal.title: Managed Terminal
managedTerminal.scope: Legacy separate-login opt-in with your macOS user privileges; not a container. Read-only/on-request startup defaults; provider UI may change permissions. Closing hides this view; process lifetime is 30 minutes. Real Codex acceptance is pending; OpenCode requires its separate explicit startup opt-in.
managedTerminal.idle: No owned process started. This optional profile uses a separate login; existing login reuse is unavailable.
managedTerminal.denied: Denied, input expired, or configuration/authentication changed. Enable input again if needed.
managedTerminal.ok: Request accepted. Process running is not provider readiness or authentication.
managedTerminal.gap: Output was evicted. Screen reconstruction and input are disabled; stop and start a new process.
managedTerminal.revoked: Input disabled. Enable keyboard input again to continue.
managedTerminal.running: Owned process running; provider readiness unverified
managedTerminal.ownership_lost: Ownership lost; no safe control or retry
managedTerminal.tooMuch: Too much terminal output. Read the remaining output visually.
managedTerminal.mcpAuthorize: Authorize one MCP task A → B → A
managedTerminal.mcpConfirm: Authorize one task and correlated result between these two running Terminal instances for up to 120 seconds. This does not prompt either agent or grant provider tools. Native login/configuration and session writes remain shared. Codex and OpenCode merge other MCPs; Claude strict selection excludes them. MCP disconnection leaves an unknown outcome and does not stop either process.
managedTerminal.mcpDenied: MCP authorization was refused or its outcome is unknown. Both opted-in Terminal instances must still be owned and running. Do not retry uncertain work.
managedTerminal.retired: Terminal pair retired; create or review fresh manifests in this window
managedTerminal.retireConfirm: Release this selection only after every owned process has exited. The metadata archive will be preserved.
managedTerminal.retireDenied: Pair cannot retire. Every dispatched process needs a confirmed owned exit; lost ownership and changed reservations remain blocked.
managedTerminal.quitNotice: Disconnect Desktop? Terminal processes may continue until their authorized deadline. Unresolved reservations remain blocked after restart.
managedTerminal.reuse_unavailable: Blocked: existing native login reuse has not been validated for interactive PTY. No Core, journal or provider was started.
managedTerminal.existing_state: Blocked: this state already has a journal. Existing reservations will not be adopted, reset or removed.
managedTerminal.capacity_reserved: Blocked: capacity is reserved or private admission cannot be verified. This opening started no process; existing reservations remain. Return to the dashboard and request evidence-backed reconciliation of the prior lifetime. Creating another selection or restarting does not release capacity. Do not delete markers, adopt sessions or signal unknown processes. This client cannot reconcile them.
managedTerminal.claudeScope: Experimental Claude Code native login reuse. HOME/config/Keychain selection, hooks, plugins, policies and native session writes stay shared; the CLI may refresh credentials. No sandbox. New UUID, one dispatch per manifest; no automatic task, login or resume. With MCP opt-in, strict selection excludes other MCP definitions and native approval can block startup. Native focus, login, MCP and provider acceptance remain pending. OpenCode has a separate explicit startup opt-in.
managedTerminal.opencodeScope: Experimental OpenCode 2.2.5 standalone with existing login identity. HOME/XDG/config/database stay native and shared. Startup opens writable SQLite, may change permissions/WAL and apply pending migrations or refresh credentials. Database and migration ledger were not inspected; pending migrations are unknown and rollback is not guaranteed. Native plugins, hooks and MCPs may execute code or provider requests at startup. No ORQST task, automatic login or resume. Not a sandbox. TUI exit does not prove descendant exit; login, session routing, MCP and provider acceptance remain unvalidated. Inline MCP merges with native definitions.
managedTerminal.opencode_startup_required: OpenCode startup is blocked. Provision a new manifest only after explicitly authorizing shared native database writes/possible migrations and native startup activity. No database was inspected or opened.
managedTerminal.openCodeStartupReview: Review OpenCode native startup effects for these exact identity selectors and binaries. Startup uses the existing writable credential/session SQLite database: it may change permissions/WAL, apply pending migrations and refresh credentials. Native plugins, hooks and MCPs may execute code, network or provider requests automatically. Pending migrations and startup activity are UNKNOWN; no rollback or descendant-exit guarantee is established. Capacity stays reserved even after TUI exit. This step starts nothing. Keep the manifests blocked unless you explicitly authorize these effects; terminal start and task grants remain separate.
managedTerminal.openCodeStartupAcknowledgment: I explicitly authorize shared native SQLite writes, possible migrations, credential refresh and native startup activity for these new processes.
managedTerminal.createOpenCodeAuthorizedReview: Create the reviewed private OpenCode manifests with the explicitly reviewed native startup effects authorized? This writes ORQST skeletons only; no Core, provider, migration or task starts now. Startup still requires its separate native confirmation. Existing reservations remain protected; descendant exit and safe OpenCode capacity retirement remain unvalidated.
managedTerminal.guide_start: 1 · Start CLI and review the native permission dialog. Opening this panel starts nothing.
managedTerminal.guide_attach: 2 · Connect output to see this process. A running process does not confirm login or provider readiness.
managedTerminal.guide_input: 3 · Enable keyboard input, then type in the terminal. Paste has its own confirmation.
managedTerminal.guide_typing: Keyboard permission granted. Type in the terminal; after two minutes or a focus change, enable input again.
managedTerminal.guide_exited: This attempt ended. Review the process status. A fresh pair requires safe retirement; do not retry uncertain work.
managedTerminal.guide_uncertain: Process ownership is uncertain. Preserve this state; automatic retry and process control are unavailable.
managedTerminal.guide_gap: Some output is no longer available. Keyboard input is blocked; review details before ending this owned process.
managedTerminal.guide_blocked: This selection cannot start. Read the reason below; you can still arrange panels or return to the dashboard.
managedTerminal.aliasScope: Letters label tabs in this selection. New manifests persist a UUID and P-UUID metadata alias; neither grants control or addresses messages. Legacy T-number labels are local to the selection and may repeat.
managedTerminal.layoutHelp: Drag this pane’s heading onto a pane button to reorder, or use Move pane earlier/later. Narrow windows page through panes. Hide preserves the document and process; Show all restores hidden panes. Layout changes disable keyboard permission; enable input again before typing.
managedTerminal.permissionHelp: Start, connect, keyboard and stop use separate native confirmations. Keep this panel in the foreground with macOS unlocked. Cancel grants no permission.
managedTerminal.hideHelp: Hiding a pane or showing the dashboard keeps its process and loaded drafts. Disconnect output only detaches the view. Stop ends this owned process; it does not prove task completion. Layout preferences are saved locally. Drafts remain in memory; restoring layout never restarts a process.
managedTerminal.forceStopHelp: Force stop can lose work. Use it only when normal Stop fails and the process is still owned. Separate Codex login applies only to the legacy profile.
managedTerminal.createMcp_codexOpenCode: Prepare optional ORQST MCP for both terminals? Codex retains native MCP definitions; OpenCode merges them. Each start and the later task grant still require separate authorization. Cross-provider delegation is unvalidated.
managedTerminal.discoverChoose: Multiple native candidates were found passively. Choose a path for the complete hash review. No executable was run.
managedTerminal.discoverMissing: No reviewed native candidate was found in the trusted local locations. You can choose an installed executable manually; the exact path and hash must still pass review. Nothing was installed or run.
managedTerminal.layoutSummary: {{visible}} of {{shown}} open panes visible · position {{position}} of {{count}}. Use the pane buttons or Focus other pane to navigate.
managedTerminal.layoutMemoryOnly: Layout saving is not confirmed. Changes remain in memory.
managedTerminal.paneMenu: Pane menu: navigation, settings and details
managedTerminal.floatingUnavailable: Docked layout. Floating geometry and per-Feature layout are not available in this terminal contract.
managedTerminal.unavailable: Native transport unavailable. Keyboard input is disabled; process state is unconfirmed.
managedTerminal.openingIncomplete: Opening is incomplete. The process attempt is retained. Inspect its state and connect output or keyboard for this same instance; no new Start was attempted.
managedTerminal.guide_openingIncomplete: The attempt identity was retained but its current state is unavailable. Refresh this instance; do not start another process or remove its reservation.

managedAgents.tauriSetup: Two fresh private profiles were selected when this preview started. Enter a model and review each start separately. Routes and tasks require their own native authorization.
managedAgents.tauriRetired: Pair retired after confirmed exits. Journals and uncertain outcomes are preserved. To select a fresh pair, safely quit and reopen the preview with new profiles.
managedAgents.title: Managed agents
managedAgents.scope: Two structured Codex terminals in this client. External observed sessions remain read-only. Opening this view starts no provider.
managedAgents.setup: Prepare two fresh private existing-login manifests with terminal:setup. On the first start, select both terminal.json files in order A, B. Each start requires its own native confirmation.
managedAgents.risk: Native login/configuration stay shared: Codex may refresh its credentials or start configured MCP servers. This is a trusted same-user process, not hard containment. Real-provider acceptance is pending.
managedAgents.instructions: Instructions for the selected source (only the exact delegation tool)
managedAgents.task: Exact read-only worker task, including one @handle
managedAgents.limits: One delegation per task; 120-second deadline; no provider approvals or automatic retry. Cost limits are advisory only. Process exit does not resolve an uncertain task outcome.
managedAgents.choose: Select two fresh existing-login terminal.json manifests: A then B
managedAgents.confirm_start: Start this new Codex process using native authentication? Review the complete executable, state, shared configuration, model and permission manifest. No task is submitted by startup.
managedAgents.confirm_delegate: Authorize these exact A instructions, B task, identities and deadline? This can incur provider costs; no enforced token or spending cap.
managedAgents.confirm_stop: Send SIGTERM only to this live owned process? This does not prove descendant cleanup.
managedAgents.ok: Operation accepted; inspect the confirmed states below.
managedAgents.cancelled: Cancelled. No native grant was signed. An unlaunched preparation can be reviewed again.
managedAgents.busy: Another native action is in progress.
managedAgents.denied: Action denied or confirmation expired. No automatic retry.
managedAgents.unavailable: Operation unavailable or uncertain. Check manifests, fresh state, native login and confirmed lifecycle below; never retry uncertain work.
managedAgents.focus_required: Bring this terminal window to the foreground, then review the action again. Native focus is required before signing; no automatic retry.
managedAgents.open_focus_required: Bring the ORQST dashboard to the foreground and open Managed agents again. Native focus is required.
managedAgents.open_unavailable: The native Managed agents view could not be requested. Use the Desktop menu or safely relaunch the client after preserving drafts and stopping owned processes.
managedAgents.working: Native authorization or startup in progress…
managedAgents.lifetime: Closing hides this view and keeps owned processes running. Quit disconnects without sending a stop signal. The host enforces a 30-minute lifetime, then SIGTERM and SIGKILL after 5 seconds; descendants are not contained and exit still needs evidence.
managedAgents.lifetime_idle: No process admitted in this view. An earlier unresolved reservation may still block startup.
managedAgents.lifetime_active: Owned processes admitted or running — hiding or quitting does not stop them.
managedAgents.lifetime_uncertain: Process state uncertain — no retry, adoption or capacity reset. Evidence-backed reconciliation required.
managedAgents.lifetime_reserved: Pair reserved — inspect confirmed exits and task outcomes before retirement.
managedAgents.lifetime_retired: Pair retired after confirmed exits. Uncertain task outcomes and journals are preserved. Start selects a fresh pair.
managedAgents.recoveryLimit: Retirement requires confirmed native exits for every dispatched process, or proof that none was dispatched, with valid ownership. After connection loss, crash or ownership loss, safe client recovery is unavailable; an owner must reconcile the evidence. Never delete the marker or journals to bypass this block.
managedAgents.retire: Review safe retirement of this reservation
managedAgents.confirm_retire: Retire this reservation using the reviewed process evidence? Every dispatched process must have a confirmed native exit. Unknown task outcomes remain unknown. No task retry, journal reset, process adoption or descendant cleanup is implied. A new pair requires fresh manifests.
managedAgents.quitNotice: Disconnect and quit: owned processes may continue. Quit sends no stop signal. Use Stop owned process and wait for confirmed exits before quitting when possible.
managedAgents.hideNotice: Hide this view while owned processes may continue? This does not stop tasks or spending. Reopen Managed agents from the tray to review states and explicitly stop an owned process.
managedAgents.name: Display name
managedAgents.allowOther: Allow this terminal to delegate to the other terminal
managedAgents.mentionHelp: Enable the source → target permission, then mention exactly one @handle in the task. Quoted code and email addresses do not route. Roles grant no authority. Each task still needs native confirmation.
managedAgents.confirm_routing: Save this identity and directed communication permission? Handles are unique within the workspace. Self-send and permission cycles are refused. This does not start a task or grant provider permissions.

studio.intro: Prepare your terminals, review the permissions, then work side by side.
studio.oldDesktop: This Desktop is running an older terminal interface. The updated Studio needs a later Desktop relaunch. Keep your drafts and running agents safe; nothing will restart here.
studio.desktopOnly: Terminal preparation is available in the ORQST Desktop app. This browser remains an observer.
studio.setupHelp: Suggested pair for a new empty test folder. Review the discovered CLI and Node paths before creating anything.
studio.next_unavailable: Preparation controls require the current Desktop interface.
studio.next_empty: Next: prepare the pair and review each native dialog. No CLI starts during preparation.
studio.next_reviewed: {{count}} terminals reviewed. Next: open the panels, then authorize each start separately.
studio.next_opened: Panels are available in this window. Their own status shows whether a process is running or blocked.
studio.reviewing: Complete or cancel the native review to continue.
studio.capacityOne: This Desktop is configured for one terminal. Pair preparation requires a limit of at least two on a later launch.
studio.advancedHelp: Existing selections and capacity reservations are preserved. Larger same-provider teams remain available in the native Terminal menu when configured.
studio.guideTitle: From setup to the first command
studio.step_prepare_help: Choose an empty test folder. Review paths, hashes, shared native identity and the separate OpenCode startup choice.
studio.step_open_help: Open the reviewed selection. Use the A/B tabs, split controls and Dashboard action without discarding the loaded document.
studio.step_start_help: In each panel: Start CLI → Connect output → Enable keyboard input. Each operation retains its own focused native confirmation.
studio.boundary: OpenCode may modify its shared native database and perform startup activity only after your explicit consent and a separate Start grant. Model, login and cross-provider delegation remain unverified.
studio.layoutHelp: One window with a grid of reviewed terminals, or one selected pane on narrow windows. Switching views preserves loaded drafts and revokes keyboard input. Pane order and layout preferences are saved locally.
studio.grantsHelp: Preparing, opening, starting and enabling keyboard input are separate steps. No automatic prompt, login or provider launch.
studio.focus_required: Click the Studio page to bring it into focus, then click the action again.
studio.denied: The click permission expired or this action is unavailable for the selection. Click Studio and try again; refresh the selection if it remains blocked.
studio.busy: Another native operation is in progress. Finish or cancel it first.
studio.unavailable: The Desktop connection is unavailable. No operation was confirmed.
studio.next_prepared: Your prepared files were kept. Continue their native review to enable opening; no manual manifest selection is needed.
studio.next_blocked: Preparation could not finish safely. Existing files and reservations were preserved. Automatic retry is unavailable; inspect the native Terminal menu before proceeding.

tauri.unavailable: Tauri terminal preparation is unavailable in this document. Use the native Prepare Tauri terminals menu; existing files and selections are preserved.
tauri.setupHelp: Prepare 1–8 Codex or Claude Code terminals in one empty test folder. The same native menu flow reviews the executable, bundled Node 24 and shared identity before creating files, then separately reviews opening. ORQST MCP is disabled.
tauri.next_unavailable: Refresh preparation or use the native Prepare Tauri terminals menu.
tauri.next_empty: Choose CLI and model, then Open. No Finder picker is used in this flow.
tauri.next_prepared: {{count}} prepared files are kept. Continue their native opening review; creation is not repeated.
tauri.next_locked: The Core is at capacity, a review is active, or an addition is incomplete or uncertain. Earlier terminal documents and processes remain available. Uncertain additions are never retried or adopted.
tauri.next_blocked: A creation attempt may have written files. Automatic creation retry is blocked. Preserve the files and inspect the native preparation result.
tauri.step_prepare_help: Choose Codex or Claude Code and 1–8 terminals. Native pickers select the reviewed executable and an empty test folder. Review hashes and shared native identity.
tauri.step_open_help: The native wizard reviews every prepared manifest before opening the retained terminal workspace. Cancelling opening keeps prepared files for a later review.
tauri.step_start_help: Use the native terminal panel for Start CLI, output connection and keyboard input, with their existing signed confirmations. Preparation submits no task or login.
tauri.boundary: Tauri preparation supports same-provider Codex or Claude Code teams only, with ORQST MCP disabled. Model choice, mixed presets and real-provider acceptance are not available through this flow.
tauri.denied: The selected workspace, model or native context changed, or the action was refused. Refresh the CLI/model catalog and review the selected project. Existing files and uncertain attempts are preserved; no action is retried.
tauri.openHelp: Choose the CLI and model for the selected workspace. Review the concrete native configuration, then confirm Open to start the CLI, connect its output and enable keyboard input.
tauri.chooseWorkspace: Select an existing workspace in the sidebar first. Its folder is validated by the native Core.
tauri.advancedHelp: Use the legacy native wizard only to explicitly choose another executable and an empty test folder. This path prepares files; startup remains separate.
tauri.advancedInitialOnly: Manual folder/executable preparation is available for the initial selection. Add a terminal to this Core with the CLI and model picker above.
tauri.catalog_ready: The installed executable matches the reviewed version. Choose a model to continue.
tauri.catalog_executable_not_found: No installation matching the reviewed CLI binary was found. The CLI may be absent or its version/hash may be unsupported. Install the reviewed version or inspect the executable in Advanced.
tauri.catalog_ambiguous_executable: Multiple installations were found. Choose the reviewed native executable explicitly in Advanced.
tauri.catalog_catalog_limited: This installation or model source could not be fully validated. Refresh the catalog, inspect the selected project, or use Advanced to review the executable.
tauri.reviewFile: Before creating files, the native confirmation shows the selections and offers Full details. The private terminal.json retains the same complete configuration afterwards.
tauri.modelUnverified: Login, model access and provider availability are checked by the native CLI when opened; no login or probe runs here.
tauri.enrollmentLimit: Additional selected terminals join the same running Core. A rejected or uncertain addition preserves earlier terminals; an uncertain result blocks further additions.
tauri.mcpPairOptIn: Prepare an experimental Codex/OpenCode communication pair
tauri.mcpPairHelp: {{source}} is the source; {{worker}} is the worker. Choose both models and review both native configurations. Then authorize one MCP task in the native Managed Terminal menu. Ask the worker to use wait_task and submit_result, and the source to use delegate_task. Opening sends no task; CLI tool support and effective models remain unverified. N-member and Feature delegation remain pending.
tauri.mcpInitialOnly: Communication pairs require a fresh initial selection. Adding MCP to an existing Core is unavailable.

tauriPreparation.retireDenied: Retirement was refused or could not be confirmed. Preserve the reservation, archives and journals. After a possibly dispatched authorization, this client stays locked; an archive may already exist. Quit and inspect the evidence before selecting fresh profiles. No automatic recovery or replay is performed.
tauriPreparation.retired: Selection retired after confirmed owned exits and Core shutdown. Quit and reopen Tauri with freshly prepared profiles to select new terminals. Old journals, metadata and uncertain outcomes are preserved. In-window reselection is not available yet.
tauriPreparation.executable: Select the reviewed Codex or Claude native executable (canonical file; no shim)
tauriPreparation.project: Select an empty disposable project folder for these terminals
tauriPreparation.create: Create only the reviewed private manifests and skeletons in this Tauri profile? The complete configuration follows. The bundled Node 24 is used. No CLI, login, task, journal or admission claim starts. Creation is separate from opening and signed startup. A partial write is retained; no uncertain write is retried.
tauriPreparation.acknowledge: I declare the selected native CLI version and acknowledge that separately authorized startup shares native login, configuration and session writes. Native hooks, plugins and MCPs may cause activity or costs. Real-provider acceptance remains pending. ORQST MCP is disabled for this preparation.
tauriPreparation.open: Open these reviewed terminals in the Tauri runtime? Review every complete manifest page. This initializes the existing Core, journals and private admission for the entire selection. It does not start a CLI; each start still requires separate signed native confirmation. Opening is a single attempt; uncertain admission remains reserved.
tauriPreparation.denied: Terminal preparation or opening could not be confirmed. Preserve any files and reservations and inspect before another attempt. No automatic retry is performed.
tauriPreparation.selected: Review this CLI, model and workspace before creating private terminal files and opening their owned runtime. Shared native login, configuration, hooks, plugins, MCPs and session writes can cause activity or costs. The subsequent Open confirmation authorizes startup, output and keyboard together. No task or login is submitted automatically. Unknown outcomes remain preserved.
tauriPreparation.mcpPair: Review this experimental Codex/OpenCode pair; Full details are available before creating files. sourceTerminalId delegates; workerTerminalId waits and returns the same taskId. Both members explicitly enable ORQST MCP in this workspace. Codex reuses native login/configuration/sessions; OpenCode merges MCP configuration and acknowledges native database migrations, hooks, plugins, MCPs, startup activity and possible costs. Subsequent signed Open is separate for each CLI. Communication still requires a separate native one-use task grant (at most 120 seconds, 4096 task bytes, 8192 result bytes). Preparation sends no task, grants no provider approval and proves no delivery, effective model or provider acceptance. Unknown outcomes remain preserved.
tauriPreparation.mcpPairApprove: Accept pair configuration; continue to Open
tauriPreparation.code_capacity_reserved: A previous terminal reservation requires evidence-backed review before a new Core can open
tauriPreparation.code_admission_invalid: The terminal reservation could not be safely verified; preserve it for review
tauriPreparation.code_startup_failed: Core startup could not be confirmed
tauriPreparation.code_startup_timeout: Core startup timed out; its effects remain unconfirmed
tauriPreparation.code_startup_eof: The Core startup channel closed before confirmation
tauriPreparation.code_startup_protocol: The Core startup reply could not be verified
tauriPreparation.code_failed: The stage could not be confirmed
tauriPreparation.code_catalog_changed: The selection changed; refresh the CLI and model list
tauriPreparation.code_selection_unavailable: The selected CLI or model is unavailable
tauriPreparation.code_capacity_exceeded: The Feature terminal limit was reached
tauriPreparation.code_review_too_large: The configuration exceeds the native review limit
tauriPreparation.failure_not_started: The terminal was not opened. This attempt did not enter terminal file creation or runtime opening.
tauriPreparation.failure_possible: The terminal outcome is uncertain. Files or runtime effects may already exist. Preserve them and inspect before another attempt; no automatic retry is performed.

tauriDesktop.enabled: Enabled; OS delivery is not confirmed
tauriDesktop.failed: Native alert preparation failed; toggle off/on to retry
tauriDesktop.exhausted: Alert limit reached for this run
tauriDesktop.limit: Up to 20 attempts per run; OS permissions, identity and Focus apply
tauriDesktop.background: Keep running when the main window closes (this run)
tauriDesktop.lifetime: Quit stops the owned Core; managed hosts require separate consent
tauriDesktop.quit: Quit ORQST and its owned Core

tauriCoreUnavailable.title: Observer unavailable
tauriCoreUnavailable.observer: The observer Core could not start or its connection was lost. Observation is unavailable.
tauriCoreUnavailable.managed: Managed terminal hosts may still be running. This screen does not determine their state or restart any process.
tauriCoreUnavailable.recovery: Automatic recovery is disabled. Review existing terminal windows before using the native Quit action. Restarting the app is not a safe retry of an owned managed session.

offlineRecovery.title: Offline administrative recovery
offlineRecovery.intro: This dedicated native mode starts no observer Core, terminal, PTY or provider. Use the native menu for each explicit phase.
offlineRecovery.instructions: Install the independent administrative trust anchor first, then capture the complete reservation before an external kernel fence. Every phase requires a new full review. No automatic restart or recovery is performed.
offlineRecovery.release: Review release preparation after kernel fence
offlineRecovery.selectBundle: Select a private recovery bundle in this application’s administrative recovery directory
offlineRecovery.sessionEnded: The private administrative helper session ended or became uncertain. This is not proof of helper exit or cancellation of an accepted operation. Preserve all recovery evidence; no helper was restarted or lease cleared.
offlineRecovery.installed: The independent administrative anchor was installed. No reservation was captured or released.
offlineRecovery.captured: The complete signed reservation snapshot was saved. The original reservation remains held.
offlineRecovery.capture_continued: The signed capture continuation completed. The original reservation remains held.
offlineRecovery.release_prepared: Administrative release is prepared. The original reservation is still present; a separate final commit review is required.
offlineRecovery.finalized: The old administrative operation committed and its exact old controls were removed. This does not guarantee global capacity or authorize automatic Open.
offlineRecovery.finalized_controls_preserved: The old administrative operation committed. Different or future controls were preserved; global capacity is not declared available.
offlineRecovery.aborted: Administrative abort completed. The original reservation and every journal remain preserved.
offlineRecovery.unconfirmed: The requested phase is blocked or its effects are uncertain. Preserve the reservation and all signed evidence. No automatic retry occurred.
